TITLE: CHAINSAW MAN FANPAGE
SUBTITLE: BLOOD, CONTRACTS, AND THE HEART OF A DEVIL
QUOTE: "Everybody's after my chainsaw heart! What about Denji's heart?!"
BIO: Set in a brutal alternate reality where Devils are born from the collective fears of humanity, Chainsaw Man follows Denji—an impoverished teenager who merges with his chainsaw-devil companion, Pochita, after being betrayed and left for dead. Drafted into Public Safety's experimental Devil Extermination Special Division 4, Denji is thrust into a relentless war of devil contracts, government conspiracies, and existential manipulation, fighting with everything he has for the simplest human desires: warm food, a roof over his head, and genuine connection.
